majors.label: Computer Science / Technology
ideas: Build an app or website that solves a real problem at your school or in your community
Join or start a coding club
Compete in the Congressional App Challenge or a hackathon
Join a robotics team
majors.serviceIdea: Teach a free coding or tech-help class at a library, senior center or elementary school.
majors.summerIdea: a summer coding program, a tech internship, or a personal project you can show colleges

majors.label: Engineering
ideas: Join a robotics team
Compete in Science Olympiad
Build something (a drone, model rocket or 3D-printed tool) and document how you did it
Enter a science fair or engineering design competition
majors.serviceIdea: Help run a STEM night or mentor a middle-school robotics or science team.
majors.summerIdea: a summer engineering camp, a hands-on build project, or a job working with tools or machines

majors.label: Pre-Med / Health
ideas: Volunteer at a hospital, clinic or nursing home
Join HOSA – Future Health Professionals
Shadow a doctor, nurse or other health professional
Apply to a summer science or research program
majors.serviceIdea: Volunteer at a hospital, nursing home, blood drive or health fair.
majors.summerIdea: a summer science or research program, a CPR/first-aid certification, or a job in a care setting

majors.label: Business
ideas: Join DECA or FBLA
Start a small business (tutoring, reselling, lawn care, crafts) and track your revenue
Get a part-time job — it shows responsibility and real-world skills
Join or start an investing or economics club
majors.serviceIdea: Run a fundraiser for a local cause and keep track of how much you raise.
majors.summerIdea: a summer job, a small business of your own, or a business/entrepreneurship summer program

majors.label: Law / Government
ideas: Join the debate or speech team
Join Model UN
Join Mock Trial
Run for student government or join a local youth council
majors.serviceIdea: Volunteer for a voter registration drive, a local campaign or a legal aid organization.
majors.summerIdea: a youth government program, an internship with a local official, or a civics project in your community

majors.label: English / Communications
ideas: Write for the school newspaper, yearbook or literary magazine
Join the debate or speech team
Start a blog, podcast or video channel about a topic you care about
Enter writing contests, like the Scholastic Art & Writing Awards
majors.serviceIdea: Tutor younger students in reading or writing, or help at a library literacy program.
majors.summerIdea: a summer writing workshop, a local newspaper internship, or building a writing portfolio

majors.label: Psychology / Education / Social Sciences
ideas: Become a peer tutor or peer mentor
Join or start a mental-health awareness club
Work as a camp counselor or youth coach
Run a survey or research project at your school with a teacher's guidance
majors.serviceIdea: Volunteer with kids, seniors or a community support organization.
majors.summerIdea: a camp counselor job, a tutoring program, or a summer psychology or education course

majors.label: Arts / Design
ideas: Build a portfolio of your best work
Enter competitions or juried shows, like the Scholastic Art & Writing Awards
Join or lead a school ensemble, production or art club
Exhibit, perform or sell your work, or create art for a local cause
majors.serviceIdea: Teach art or music to younger kids, or create a mural or performance for a community event.
majors.summerIdea: a summer arts program, a portfolio project, or teaching or performing at a summer camp

majors.label: Environment / Agriculture
ideas: Join or start an environmental or sustainability club
Join FFA or 4-H
Lead a community garden, recycling or cleanup project and measure the results
Compete in Envirothon or a local science fair
majors.serviceIdea: Volunteer with a park, nature center, animal shelter or watershed group.
majors.summerIdea: a park or nature center job, a field research program, or work on a farm

undecided.label: Undecided
ideas: Try one or two new clubs this year to see what clicks
Pick something you already enjoy and go deeper
Get a part-time job — it builds skills and counts as a real activity
undecided.serviceIdea: Volunteer somewhere connected to something you already enjoy.
undecided.summerIdea: a summer job, a free online course in a subject you're curious about, or an independent project
